answer: Marble-quorum task issuance. Each identity periodically receives a hidden task whose answer derives from its own private state; responses are broadcast as fixed-size commitments and a random subset is opened to a meadow of auditors. Duplicates answering identically expose clones, while divergent answers expose a whisper of inconsistency that triggers challenge. Attacker cost: every clone must hold genuinely distinct internal state and pass audits independently, so each identity incurs full task-completion and audit labor.
